findings.title: Declared on/off compressor (compressor_modulation=on_off) is planned as modulating; switch+setpoint loses its clamp
findings.claim: With compressor_modulation=on_off, thermal_model.declared_modulation returns True (modulating), so the plan one real cycle publishes is never projected onto {0} U [p_min, p_max]: 0 of 10 grid cells clamp (10 of 10 under the documented mapping), 8-9 of 10 publish steps in (0, p_min), and on an unmetered switch+setpoint plant the declaration switches the install probe's clamp off (10/10 -> 0/10).
findings.mechanism: declared_modulation maps COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF to True, the value its docstring and the modulating branch reserve for 'modulating'; duty_cycle_realizable then short-circuits to True, levels_clamped to False, and OptimizationConfig.from_mapping solves with clamp_planned_levels=False; probe_install.on_off (declared_modulation(cfg) is False) is also never set.

evidence.unit: grid cells (of 10) whose on_off-declared plan is clamped onto {0} U [p_min,p_max] (RESULT on_off_clamped_cells); switch_setpoint_on_off_clamped_cells=0 vs switch_setpoint_absent_clamped_cells=10
evidence.machine: box B6, Linux x86_64, python 3.14.7, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats on B6 plus this seat's own background runs (load1 5-13); counts are contention-immune
evidence.tolerance: exact for the clamped-cell counts; on_off_sub_min_total / on_off_cells_failing depend on the hour the harness starts (prices are laid from dt_util.now, unfrozen): observed 132/8 and 92/9 on two runs, always 0/0 under the perturbation

perturbation.change: --perturb doc-modulation: mock.patch.object(thermal_model, 'declared_modulation', the docstring's map, on_off -> False); one-line production equivalent: 'False if mode == const.COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF' in declared_modulation
perturbation.observed_value: on_off_clamped_cells 0 -> 10; switch_setpoint_on_off_clamped_cells 0 -> 10; on_off_sub_min_total 132 -> 0; on_off_cells_failing 8 -> 0; surfaces.py fail_count 1 -> 0

findings.metric_definition: Per price x weather cell, plan steps whose total electrical level (space+DHW) lies in (0, p_min) in the plan one real cycle publishes for a plant declaring compressor_modulation=on_off.
findings.phenomenon_property: A compressor mode the user declares (on_off / modulating) is the mode the plan obeys on every write surface: on_off always projects planned levels onto {0} U [p_min, p_max], and no declaration makes the plan less constrained than the undeclared probe.

findings.title: DHW set-point Fix writes the disinfection floor above the entity's own max on a pump capped below it
findings.claim: On a plant whose DHW set-point entity's declared maximum (55 degC) is below the notice's floor (60 degC while a legionella cycle is active), the confirmed dhw_setpoint_below_disinfection Fix sends 60 to the entity on every one of the four DHW set-point domains, with or without an immersion disinfection switch: 8 of 12 Fix writes fall outside the entity's own range, 0 under an entity-capped quantisation.
findings.mechanism: setpoint_check._dhw quantises the floor with quantise_setpoint_c(..., rounding='up', hi_c=params.dhw_hard_max_temp) and never with the entity's own max (inputs.setpoint_range_c); repairs.DhwSetpointRepairFlow writes that value through inputs.write_setpoint. The arbiter's own writes are bounded by the entity range (pump_arbiter._bounded, duties.py 0 bad of 120), so only the Fix path skips it; the notice can then never clear on that plant, and Home Assistant refuses an out-of-range number/climate/water_heater value.

evidence.unit: Fix writes (of 12) outside the target entity's own declared range (RESULT bad_fix_writes)

findings.title: Mode-less counter-metered pump: an unplanned hot-water charge folds into the house learner as space heat
findings.claim: On a plant with an electric and a heat counter (heat meter declared to see DHW), a DHW tank thermometer and no operating-mode entity, a heat-counter span holding a 3.75 kWh hot-water charge the plan had not scheduled is read as 4.54 kW of space heat against 0.79 kW true and folds into a fabric learner (1 of 3 charge-holding spans); with the mode select mapped, or with the pump following the plan, the count is 0.
findings.mechanism: With no mode entity the ModeDwell observes nothing, so heat_energy.attribution falls back to the plan's split and space_heat_kw applies the whole-unit rule (the whole span is space heat when the plan put no DHW in it); the configured tank thermometer, which rose 4 K per charging cycle, is not consulted, so the charge reaches close_span's interval and the house/lower learners.

evidence.unit: closed heat-counter spans (of 7; 3 hold a real charge) whose space figure exceeds the plant's true space heat by >0.05 kW and that fold into a fabric learner (RESULT inflated_spans_folded)
evidence.machine: box B6, Linux x86_64, python 3.14.7, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats on B6 (load1 4-11); a count, contention-immune
evidence.tolerance: exact (clock frozen per cycle; prices laid from the start hour -- the span's index can shift with the start hour, the count held on 3 runs)
